corrected.reason: Advanced Armour is Feel No Pain 4+ against mortal wounds only. The upstream effect has no qualifier, so the app rendered an unrestricted Feel No Pain 4+ — a much stronger ability than the Broadside has, and exactly the kind of confidently wrong number that loses games.

In 11th edition Stealth gives the unit the Benefit of Cover. Upstream still carries the 10th edition rule, -1 to the attacker's Hit roll, in all three faction files. Reported by the app's user against the current rulebook. The two are not interchangeable: cover changes the save, a hit penalty changes the roll, and they stack differently with everything else on the table.
